settings.dock-width.label: Dock width
settings.dock-width.multiHint: Per-display widths are active — adjust below.
settings.exportHint: Everything is included by default — untick what should stay out of the file.
settings.guardBody: You have unsaved changes. Save them, discard them, or keep editing — no changes are saved until you say so.
settings.install-dir.hint: Where installs land. Empty means the installer default. Never exported; the Plan flags installers that ignore it.
settings.install-dir.label: Install directory
settings.language.hint: English or Simplified Chinese for every label and hint. Applies at once.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.launch-concurrency.hint: How many Quick Launch apps start at once; the rest queue. 1–50 apps, default 8.
settings.launch-concurrency.label: Launch concurrency
settings.log-retention.hint: Keeps a finished run's raw logs this long. Prunes after every run and at start; the runs list is never deleted. 1–3650 days, default 30.
settings.log-retention.label: Log retention
settings.modelGone: The previously selected managed model is no longer installed, so AI assistance is set to Off — Save to keep it.
settings.modelNameFirst: Name the model your local service exposes. Unknown names fail instead of swapping.
settings.native-frame.hint: Sprout's own bar with window buttons, or the Windows titlebar. Native helps when the custom header glitches.
settings.native-frame.label: Window frame
settings.noMatchHint: Try a different name, or clear the filter to see every setting.
settings.nothingToRestore: Nothing to restore — everything in the file already exists.
settings.per-monitor.hint: Each display remembers its edge, mode, width, and tab position; the defaults above cover the rest. Saves below; applies on next dock.
settings.per-monitor.label: Per-monitor dock
settings.perMonitorFail: Some per-monitor choices couldn't be saved — see the rows below.
settings.pickerFail: Couldn't open the folder picker — type the path directly instead.
settings.restoreEmpty: This file contains no items to restore.
settings.restoreKept: Items that already exist here are kept — nothing is overwritten.
settings.restoredSkippedMany: Restored {restored}. {count} items were already present and kept.
settings.restoredSkippedOne: Restored {restored}. {count} item was already present and kept.
settings.reveal-dwell.hint: Hold time at the edge before the hidden dock slides out. Shorter fires on grazes; longer needs a hold. 0–1000 ms, default 200.
settings.reveal-dwell.label: Reveal delay
settings.reveal-sensitivity.hint: How far the cursor pushes into the edge before the hold timer starts. Lower answers at once; higher ignores brushes. 0–50 px, default 12.
settings.reveal-sensitivity.label: Reveal sensitivity
settings.saveAnimationFail: Couldn't save the animation switch — it applies for now, but won't survive a restart.
settings.saveFail: Couldn't save the settings — try again. If it keeps failing, close Sprout and relaunch.
settings.saveFrameFail: Couldn't save the window frame — it applies for now, but won't survive a restart.
settings.saveLanguageFail: Couldn't save the language — it applies for now, but won't survive a restart.
settings.saveThemeFail: Couldn't save the theme — it applies for now, but won't survive a restart.
settings.savedRun: Saved — the next run honors these.
settings.subtitle: Defaults for authoring and housekeeping, persisted in the Library database and honored by every run.
settings.theme.hint: Follows Windows, or pins light or dark. Applies at once.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.updates.hint: Checks GitHub releases for a newer build. Installing downloads it and restarts Sprout.
settings.updates.label: Sprout updates
test.note: Runs the command timeboxed (20 s) and reports the exit code and output — a command that outlives the box is interactive, not headless-verifiable.
test.timeoutBody: Timed out — not headless-verifiable. The command is interactive (or hangs); it was killed after 20 s.
update.confirmNote: Sprout restarts when the installer finishes.
update.feedFail: Couldn't reach the release feed just now — try again later.
update.installingNote: Installing Sprout {version} — Sprout restarts when it finishes.
viewer.errorBody: The image couldn't be read. Press Esc to close.
viewer.missingBody: It was deleted or moved. Press Esc to close.
viewer.title: Clip viewer
